verdict.rationale: Formant documents public APIs and SDKs for driving the platform programmatically. Its docs describe an Admin API (used, for example, to create custom commands), a query API and an ingestion API reachable through the Python Cloud SDK, and APIs and SDKs to ingest data and configure devices. The GitHub toolkit for building apps on Formant's APIs corroborates this. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes all returned 404), in-depth endpoint reference evidence covering full platform control, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven usage.
